comments.text: Nihari was a concoction created by Emperor Shahjehan’s chefs on his orders to provide a breakfast to the labourers and workers building the Taj Mahal, which would be fed to them for breakfast. It provided extra energy and strength and was so filling that they could keep working throughout the day without needing a lunch break. Shahjehan was anxious that the Taj Mahal be completed before he died so that heould be buried in it next to his beloved wife Mumtaz Mahal for whom the Taj Mahal was built
